aries.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Aries today.
aries.deploy_today: No — The stars are reading your diff. They have concerns.
aries.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Aries today. Your standup is in four minutes and you have not started the task you said was done yesterday.

taurus.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Taurus today.
taurus.deploy_today: No — Stability is the Taurus gift. Don't squander it on a Sunday deploy.
taurus.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Taurus today. So is your IDE. You have been staring at a blank file for twenty minutes. This is called planning.

gemini.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Gemini today.
gemini.deploy_today: Maybe — You'll open the deploy pipeline, close it, open it again, and then go to lunch.
gemini.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Gemini today. You have opened six tickets, closed two, and forgotten why you opened the others.

cancer.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Cancer today.
cancer.deploy_today: No — You have a bad feeling about this. You always have a bad feeling. This time you're right.
cancer.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Cancer today. You will feel something is wrong with production. You will check. You were right. It is always you.

leo.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Leo today.
leo.deploy_today: Yes — Leo demands an audience. The deploy notification has 0 reactions. Leo is devastated.
leo.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Leo today. Your one-line fix has seventeen reviewers. None of them have opened it.

virgo.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Virgo today.
virgo.deploy_today: No — You found a potential issue in a file that's not even part of this change.
virgo.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Virgo today. You will spend the silence auditing the codebase for issues that don't exist yet. You will find one.

libra.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Libra today.
libra.deploy_today: Maybe — The pros and cons list is perfectly balanced. That's the problem.
libra.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Libra today. You have been asked to pick a tech stack. You asked for two weeks. That was two months ago.

scorpio.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Scorpio today.
scorpio.deploy_today: No — You've already read the logs three times looking for signs. The logs are hiding something.
scorpio.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Scorpio today. You know it's too quiet. You are already checking the monitoring dashboard. Something blinked.

sagittarius.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Sagittarius today.
sagittarius.deploy_today: Yes — You pushed before reading your own PR description. No regrets. Some regrets.
sagittarius.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Sagittarius today. You are not. You have sent eight Slack messages before anyone else has opened their laptop.

capricorn.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Capricorn today.
capricorn.deploy_today: Yes — You planned this deploy two weeks ago. The plan survives contact with reality. Barely.
capricorn.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Capricorn today. You have already written the quarterly report, updated the roadmap, and filed three retrospective action items. It is 8:47 AM.

aquarius.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Aquarius today.
aquarius.deploy_today: Maybe — You've refactored the deploy script to use a language you invented last week.
aquarius.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Aquarius today. You have used the quiet to migrate the entire auth system to a new framework. Nobody asked. You have opinions.

pisces.horoscope_text: The cosmos are quiet for Pisces today.
pisces.deploy_today: No — You've been staring at the PR for an hour. The PR is fine. You are not fine.
pisces.prophecy: The cosmos are quiet for Pisces today. You have read the same function three times and changed nothing. You will read it again. The function is watching you.
